# Import packages
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(expss)
library(networkD3)
library(ggalluvial)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
library(paletteer)
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)


dir.create(here('Results'),  showWarnings = F)
dir.create(here('Results/Microbiome/'),  showWarnings = F)
dir.create(here('Figures'), showWarnings = F)
```


## Load data
### FLIP
```{r}
FLIP_Clinical <- read_csv(here("Data/FLIP1_ClinicalData.csv"))
# FLIP <-clean_names(FLIP)

FLIP_MicrobiomeParams <- read_csv(here("Data/Microbiome_Parameters_FLIP_VMET2.csv"))

FLIP_Data <- merge(FLIP_Clinical, FLIP_MicrobiomeParams, by='Sequencing Name')

FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Type` == "Participant sample")

FLIP_Data <- FLIP_Data %>%  mutate(Outcome = case_when(Outcome == "Term" ~ "Term",
                                                    Outcome == "iPTB" ~ "iPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "sPTB" ~ "sPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "SPTB" ~ "sPTB",))

# Omit edge cases of pregnancy with rescue cerclage samping and T6A and T3.5
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E29')
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E186')
```

# Import the VMET Data
```{r}
VMET_Data <- read_csv(here("Data/VMET2_ComparisonCohort_ClinicalData.csv"))

VMET_Data <- merge(VMET_Data, FLIP_MicrobiomeParams, by='Sequencing Name')
```

# Import the 16S data counts matrix
```{r}
species_16S <- read_tsv('./Data/16S Data/Species/table.tsv', skip = 1)

Matrix_16S <- t(species_16S[, 2:ncol(species_16S)])
colnames(Matrix_16S) <- species_16S$`#OTU ID`
rownames(Matrix_16S) <- NULL
species_16S <- as_tibble(cbind(`Sequencing Name` = colnames(species_16S[, 2:ncol(species_16S)]), Matrix_16S))

# Keep FLIP only, raw counts not used for VMET2
FLIP_16S <- merge(FLIP_Data, species_16S, by="Sequencing Name")

rm(Matrix_16S)
```

### Unified colour scheme
```{r}
table(FLIP_Data$colonisation_status)


CST_colours <-c("#004d00", "#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#b22222","#c62828", "#e34234","#800080")

CST_colour_table <- rbind(table(FLIP_Data$CST), CST_colours)

subCST_colour_table<- data.frame(rbind(table(FLIP_Data$subCST), subCST_colour))


cst_colors_subsets <- c(
  "I-A" = "#004d00",
  "I-B" = "#228b22",
  "II" = "#66cdaa",
  "III-A" = "#ffcc00",
  "III-B" = "#ff8c00",
  "IV-A" = "#b22222",
  "IV-B" = "#c62828",
  "IV-C0" = "#e34234",
  "IV-C2" = "#F28B84",
  "IV-C3" = "#ffc0cb",

df <- data.frame(
  CST = factor(names(cst_colors_subsets), levels = names(cst_colors_subsets)),
  Color = cst_colors_subsets)
```

### Define a custom plotting theme to use in figure panel subplots
```{r}
theme_custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),  
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
}
```

## Dotplot of sampling distribution
### FLIP
```{r, warning=FALSE}
table(FLIP_Data$CST)

sampling_dotplot_gest_age <- ggplot(FLIP_Data, aes(x=`Gestational Age (weeks)`, y=`FLIP number`)) +
        geom_point(aes(x=`Gestational Age (weeks)`, 
                       color = CST), size = 3, alpha = 0.8)+ 
        scale_colour_manual(values = c( "#228b22", "#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#b22222","#c62828", "#e34234","#800080")) +
        xlab("Gestational age (weeks)")+ ylab("Pregnancy ID") +
        facet_grid(Outcome ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free")+
        guides(colour=guide_legend(title="VALENCIA CST")) + theme_light()+ 
        theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))    


#ggsave(here("Figures", "dotplot_FLIP_only_GestAge.png"), sampling_dotplot_gest_age, width =7, height = 15, dpi = 200, units = "in", device='png')


FLIP_ordered <- FLIP_Data %>% mutate(test = paste(Timepoint, CST, sep = "_"))  

table(FLIP_ordered$subCST)

FLIP_t0 <- FLIP_Data %>%  mutate(order = case_when( Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "I-A"   ~ 1,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "I-B"   ~ 2,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "II"    ~ 3,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "III-A" ~ 4,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "III-B" ~ 5,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "IV-A"  ~ 6,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "IV-B"  ~ 7,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "IV-C0" ~ 8,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "IV-C2" ~ 9,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "IV-C3" ~ 10,
                                                    Timepoint == "T0" & subCST == "V"     ~ 11))


# Arrange and filter to get unique flip_number levels based on order
unique_flip_numbers <- FLIP_t0 %>%
  arrange(desc(order)) %>%
  distinct(`FLIP number`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pull(`FLIP number`)

# Now set flip_number as a factor with levels in the correct order
FLIP_t0$`FLIP number` <- factor(FLIP_t0$`FLIP number`, levels = unique_flip_numbers)
FLIP_ord_subset <- FLIP_t0[complete.cases(FLIP_t0[, c("Timepoint", "FLIP number", "subCST", "colonisation_status")]), ]
nrow(FLIP_ord_subset)

FLIP_ord <- FLIP_t0
  
colonisation_status<- as.factor(FLIP_ord$colonisation_status)

dotPlot_FLIP <- ggplot(FLIP_ord, aes(x = Timepoint, y = `FLIP number`, color = subCST, 
                            shape = colonisation_status)) +  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("#004d00", "#228b22","#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#ff8c00", "#b22222","#c62828", "#e34234", "#F28B84","#ffc0cb", "#800080", "gray")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("non-coloniser" = 16, "coloniser" = 17),
  labels = c("non-coloniser" = "No", "coloniser" = "Yes"), name = "LACTIN-V detected") + 
  xlab("Timepoint") +  ylab("Pregnancy ID") +  
  facet_grid(Outcome ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Valencia CST"), 
         shape = guide_legend(title = "LACTIN-V detected")) + theme_light() +
 theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18))
 

# ggsave(here("Figures/dotplot_FLIP.png"), dotPlot_FLIP, width = 9, height = 15, dpi = 400)
# ggsave(here("Figures/dotplot_FLIP.svg"), dotPlot_FLIP, width = 9, height = 15, dpi = 400)
```

# Data Analysis
## Distribution of CSTs across timepoints
### Sankey plot FLIP
```{r}
FLIP_sankey <- FLIP_ord %>% select(`FLIP number`, Timepoint, Outcome, CST)

table(FLIP_sankey$CST)

wide_data <- FLIP_sankey %>%
  rename(subject = `FLIP number`,   # Use your actual subject ID column name
         CST = CST) %>%
  select(subject, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST)
  
  long_alluvial <- wide_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("T"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "CST") %>%
  arrange(subject, Timepoint)


sankey_FLIP <- ggplot(long_alluvial,
       aes(x = Timepoint, stratum = CST, alluvium = subject,
           fill = CST, label = CST)) +
  geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback",
            color = "darkgray") +
  geom_stratum() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#228b22", "#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#b22222","#c62828", "#e34234", "#800080", "gray"), 
                    labels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "V", "No sample")) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(count)), size = 5, color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  #theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
        theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+ xlab("Timepoint")

# ggsave(here("Figures/Sankey_FLIP_cst_transitions.png"), sankey_FLIP, width = 15, height = 9, dpi= 300)
# ggsave(here("Figures/Sankey_FLIP_cst_transitions.svg"), sankey_FLIP, width = 15, height = 9, dpi= 300)
```

### FLIP Sankey plot FLIP T0 -> T3 
```{r}
FLIP_timepoint0_3 <- FLIP_ord %>% filter(Timepoint == "T0" |Timepoint == "T3" )

FLIP_T0T3_sankey <- FLIP_timepoint0_3 %>% select(`FLIP number`, Timepoint, Outcome, CST)

table(FLIP_T0T3_sankey$CST)

wide_data <- FLIP_T0T3_sankey %>%
  rename(subject = `FLIP number`,   # Use your actual subject ID column name
         CST = CST) %>%
  select(subject, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST)
  
  long_alluvial <- wide_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("T"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "CST") %>%
  arrange(subject, Timepoint)
  
sankey_to_t3 <- ggplot(long_alluvial,
       aes(x = Timepoint, stratum = CST, alluvium = subject,
           fill = CST, label = CST)) +
  geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback",
            color = "darkgray") +
  geom_stratum() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#228b22", "#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#b22222","#c62828", "#e34234", "#800080", "gray"), 
                    labels = c("I", "II", "III", "IV-A", "IV-B", "IV-C", "V", "No sample")) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(count)), size = 5, color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
        theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + ggtitle("FLIP")

#ggsave(here("Figures/Sankey_plot_cst_transitions_FLIP_T0_T3.png"), sankey_to_t3, width = 9, height = 9, dpi= 300)
```

### VMET2 Sankey plot A -> B
```{r}
VMET_AB <- VMET_ordered %>% filter(VMET_ordered$Timepoint == "A" |VMET_ordered$Timepoint  == "B" )

VMET_AB_sankey <- VMET_AB %>% select(`V2 Number`, Timepoint, Outcome, CST)

table(VMET_AB_sankey$CST)

wide_data <- VMET_AB_sankey %>%
  rename(subject = `V2 Number`,   
         CST = CST) %>%
  select(subject, Timepoint, CST) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CST)
  
  
  long_alluvial <- wide_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("A", "B"),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "CST") %>%
  arrange(subject, Timepoint)
  
  
sankey_AB <- ggplot(long_alluvial,
       aes(x = Timepoint, stratum = CST, alluvium = subject,
           fill = CST, label = CST)) +
  geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", lode.guidance = "frontback",
            color = "darkgray") +
  geom_stratum() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#228b22", "#66cdaa","#ffcc00","#c62828", "#e34234", "#800080", "gray")) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(count)), size = 5, color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1), legend.position =  "right") + ggtitle("VMET2")


#ggsave(here("Figures/Sankey_plot_cst_transitions_VMET_A_B.png"), sankey_AB, width = 9, height = 9, dpi= 300)  
```

### Assemble combined FLIP-VMET2 sankey plot figure
```{r}
combined_Sankey <- (sankey_AB + theme_custom_plot() + theme(legend.position="none")) + (sankey_to_t3 + theme_custom_plot())
combined_Sankey <- combined_Sankey 

ggsave(here('./Figures/Microbiome_VMETFLIPSankey.png'), combined_Sankey, dpi=300, width = 183, height = 110,  units = "mm")
ggsave(here('./Figures/Microbiome_VMETFLIPSankey.svg'), combined_Sankey, dpi=300, width = 183, height = 110,  units = "mm",
  device = svglite::svglite, fix_text_size = FALSE)

# Save the ggplot/patchwork object so other notebooks can reuse it as a native (vector) panel
saveRDS(combined_Sankey, here('./Figures/Microbiome_VMETFLIPSankey.rds'))
```

# Bacterial load and Lactin-V boxplots across time - split by Coloniser vs Non-coloniser
```{r}
responder_colour <- c("Responder" =  "#619CFF", "Non-responder" =  "coral")

BactLoad_boxplot <- ggplot(FLIP_Data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(`Total_Bacterial_Load_16SCopyNo/ml`))) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, aes(fill=Responder), alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE,  linewidth = 0.5) + 
  geom_jitter(aes(col = CST), size = 2) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = cst_colors, name='CST') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = responder_colour) +  
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Responder", "Non-responder")),
    method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = FALSE) +
  labs(y = "log10(Bacterial 16S copies per ml)") + theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),                    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),                  
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour='white'))
```

## FLIP 16S Count matrix heatmap
```{r}
orderedFLIPDataset <- cbind(FLIP_16S[, 1:32],  FLIP_16S[, 33:ncol(FLIP_16S)][, order(colSums(apply(FLIP_16S[, 33:ncol(FLIP_16S)], 2, as.numeric)), decreasing=T)])

orderedFLIPDataset <- tibble::as_tibble(orderedFLIPDataset)
orderedFLIPDataset[, 33:ncol(orderedFLIPDataset)] <- apply(orderedFLIPDataset[, 33:ncol(orderedFLIPDataset)], 2, as.numeric)

expression_data_scaled <- log(t(orderedFLIPDataset[, 33:(32 + 50)]) + 1)

colnames(expression_data_scaled) <- orderedFLIPDataset$`Sample Name`

bacterialNames <- colnames(orderedFLIPDataset)[33:ncol(orderedFLIPDataset)]

parse_taxonomy <- function(tax_string) {

  levels <- strsplit(tax_string, ";")[[1]]
  skip_values <- c("unidentified", "uncultured", "unknown", 
                   "metagenome", "uncultured_bacterium", "uncultured_Gemella",
                   "Clostridiales_bacterium", "Anaerococcus_sp.")
  
  for (i in length(levels):1) {
    prefix <- sub("^([a-z]?)__.*", "\\1", levels[i])
    value <- sub("^[a-z]?__", "", levels[i])
    
    if (nchar(value) > 0 && !tolower(value) %in% skip_values) {
      if (prefix == "s") {
        return(value)}
      return(paste0(prefix, "_", value)) }
  }
  return(NA_character_)}

rownames(expression_data_scaled) <-  as.character(sapply(bacterialNames, parse_taxonomy))[1:50]

maxCol <- max(abs(expression_data_scaled))
breaks = seq(-maxCol, maxCol, length.out = 100)

col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-maxCol, 0, maxCol), c("steelblue4", "white", "firebrick4"))
col_fun = colorRamp2(c(0, maxCol), c("steelblue3", "firebrick3"))

col_fun = colorRamp2(c(0, maxCol), hcl_palette = "Viridis")


eragny_full  <- paletteer_d("impressionist.colors::la_recolte_des_foins_eragny", n = 12)
n_timepoints <- 7
palette_length <- length(eragny_full)
colour_idx <- round(seq(1, palette_length, length.out = n_timepoints))
eragny_colors <- eragny_full[colour_idx]
timepoint_colors <- setNames(as.character(eragny_colors), c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))


heatmapHeader_Col <- columnAnnotation(`Outcome`=orderedFLIPDataset$Outcome,
                                      `Timepoint`= orderedFLIPDataset$Timepoint,
                                      `CST`= orderedFLIPDataset$CST,
                                      col = list(`Outcome`=c(`sPTB`= "tomato3", `iPTB`= "darkorange", `Term`= "deepskyblue4"), 
                                                 `Timepoint` = timepoint_colors,
                                                 `CST`=CST_colour_table[2, ]),
                              gp = gpar(col = "grey75"))


microbiomeHeatmap <- Heatmap(as.matrix(expression_data_scaled), col=col_fun, name = "log(count + 1)", 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface="italic"),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16),
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.3),  
        show_column_dend = TRUE,  
        show_row_dend = TRUE, 
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        cluster_rows = F,
        column_dend_height = unit(40, "mm"),
        column_dend_gp = gpar(padding = unit(c(1000, 1000, 200, 100), "mm")),
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_side = "top", 
        #left_annotation =  heatmapHeader, 
        top_annotation = heatmapHeader_Col,
        row_dend_side = 'left') 

png(file=here('./Figures/FLIP_Metataxonomic_Heatmap.png'), width = 1800, height=1600)
draw(microbiomeHeatmap, padding = unit(c(10, 40, 20, 20), "mm"))
dev.off()

svg(file=here('./Figures/FLIP_Metataxonomic_Heatmap.svg'), width = 18, height=16)
draw(microbiomeHeatmap, padding = unit(c(10, 40, 20, 20), "mm"))
dev.off()
```
